title: The Window
cn: 第 10 集 · 机会之窗
novel:
Ted had loved a woman named Maggie for years. She was always with someone else. But tonight, Ted learned, she was single — and the [[window|window]] to act was tiny. By morning she would be taken again.

Barney [[insisted|insist]] that Ted needed a new [[suit|suit]]. "Confidence comes from [[fabric|fabric]]," he declared. "A [[confident|confident]] man grabs what he wants."

Ted [[rushed|rush]] across town, racing against the clock. But at every turn, an [[obstacle|obstacle]] appeared. A flat tire. A lost [[umbrella|umbrella]]. A long line at the coffee shop.

By the time Ted reached Maggie's door, another man was already there, [[charming|charm]] her with ease.

Ted [[hesitated|hesitate]]. Then he [[grabbed|grab]] his courage and knocked anyway. Maggie opened the door, and for a [[brief|brief]] moment she smiled.

But the moment passed. She chose the other man. Ted walked home alone, [[defeated|defeat]] but strangely at peace. Some [[opportunities|opportunity]], he realized, closed no matter how fast you ran. The [[trick|trick]] was knowing when to stop chasing.

window.en: a short period when something can be done

insist.en: to demand firmly that something happen

suit.en: a set of matching jacket and trousers

confident.en: sure that you can do something well

rush.en: to move or do something very quickly

umbrella.en: a thing you hold to keep rain off you

charm.en: to please someone with your manner

hesitate.en: to pause because you are unsure

grab.en: to take hold of something suddenly

trick.en: a clever way of doing something
